stopped_because: ran the 5 iterations it was given

fields.name: placed
fields.description: Ordered list of the colors of the cubes that have been put into the bin so far, one entry per completed 'put it into the bin' subgoal, oldest first. The literal empty list [] at step #1, written explicitly and never left blank; at every later step the field is again an explicit list. At the decision step that directly follows an execution of B (the execution steps show a cube held in the gripper and then released over the bin, and the scene at the decision step shows the gripper open with nothing held), append the color of the cube that was held during that execution. Never append after a pick-up execution (one that ends with a cube held) and never after pressing the button. Count released cubes even if a cube of that color later appears somewhere on the table, since the bin is opaque and detections near it are unreliable. e.g. ["green", "green"]

fields.name: cubes
fields.description: Ordered list of the cubes of the goal colors that are on the table and not yet picked, oldest first, each entry as [color, [y, x]] with the position as last seen. Age on the table is what the list preserves: a cube present at the start of the episode precedes every cube that appeared during execution, and among cubes that appeared during execution the earlier arrival precedes the later. At step #1 fill it with every visible cube of a goal color, ordered by distance to the reference point that lies 10 px to the larger-x side of the reported bin center (reference = [bin_y, bin_x + 10]; the bin's visible-pixel centroid sits to the robot's right of its true center), nearest first (ties: smaller y). The reported bin center itself is not the reference. At every later step copy the carried list, then (a) remove the entry of the cube that this step's own execution steps show the fingers closing on (opening dropping from about 100% to about 46%) and then reported 'held in the gripper'; when the execution steps open with a cube already held, remove nothing for it, since that removal was made at the previous step, (b) append, in order of first appearance, every cube of a goal color that first appears during the execution steps at a place where no entry already lies (matching is one-to-one per frame: each existing entry absorbs at most one detection, the nearest goal-color detection within about 10 px of its position, and that entry keeps its slot with only its position refreshed; a further detection in the same frame that lies within 10 px of an already-matched entry but has no unmatched entry within about 10 px is a new cube and is appended at its first appearance; a detection about 10 px or more from every entry is a different cube, not a drifted one; an entry is never dropped and re-appended; a cube briefly not reported because the arm covers it keeps its entry; a detection within about 10 px of the reported bin center is at the bin's position and is not a cube, whereas a detection 20 px or more from the bin center is a table cube and is appended even if it appeared right after a release; a detection that appears only in frames where a cube is held and lies within about 10 px of the held cube's position is the held cube, not a new one), and (c) refresh each remaining entry's position to its latest reported position. Cubes of colors the goal does not name are never entered. Write it as a JSON array with double-quoted color strings. e.g. [["blue", [54, 118]], ["blue", [87, 181]], ["blue", [53, 102]]]
